title: Tent View of Mountain Landscape
summary: This prompt generates a breathtaking photo from inside a tent, looking out at a stunning mountain landscape at dawn. It focuses on framing the view of an alpine lake and snow-capped peaks, blending interior and exterior.
prompt: A breathtaking photo from the perspective of someone sitting inside a tent, looking out at a stunning mountain landscape at dawn. The tent opening frames the view of a crystal-clear alpine lake and snow-capped peaks catching the first rays of sun. The interior of the tent is cozy, with a sleeping bag and a metal camping mug. This requires complex spatial understanding and the ability to blend interior and exterior scenes seamlessly. –ar 3:2
